content.text: {"user_request":"请分析参考图中的一个指定元素: 彩色圆片堆中最左上方的绿色齿轮状圆片, 包含中心孔和外轮廓。以过程式 Shader 复现为目标, 独立分析可见特征、关系、候选实现机制和草图方案, 明确不确定项与缺口。本轮只分析该目标。","target_element":{"id":"E1","name":"最左上方绿色齿轮状圆片","region":"原图左侧彩色堆叠区域中最左上方的绿色圆片, 包含中心孔和外轮廓","feature_ids":[]},"scope":"原图左侧彩色堆叠区域中最左上方的绿色圆片, 包含中心孔和外轮廓","direction":"围绕目标的可见特征和相互关系, 提出可用于过程式 Shader 的实现机制和草图。","draft":{"stage":"observations","revision":1,"target_id":"E1","evidence_links":{},"context_notes":[],"open_questions":[],"gaps":[],"observations":[{"id":"F1","description":"绿色齿轮状圆片主体: 近圆形扁平底盘, 纯色绿色平面填充, 无渐变、纹理、描边或投影; 原图外接包围盒约 (200,346)-(322,469), 即约 122×123px、中心约 (261,407), 含齿瓣的最大半径约 61px, 整体近正圆(纵横比≈1)。","candidates":[]},{"id":"F2","description":"齿轮状外缘: 外缘由沿圆周均布的圆凸瓣与圆滑凹口交替构成, 当前读数约 8 瓣/8 凹口(待精确复核); 瓣顶与凹口底部均为圆滑曲线、无尖角; 径向起伏平缓, 估计瓣顶半径≈61px、凹底半径≈52-55px; 齿廓整体相位基准角未精确锚定。","candidates":[]},{"id":"F3","description":"中心孔: 白底色近正圆孔位于圆片中心, 与外缘同心(目测偏心可忽略); 孔半径估计约 15-18px, 约为外缘最大半径的 0.25-0.30。","candidates":[]},{"id":"F4","description":"边界与填充质量: 外缘、凹口与孔缘均为约 1px 级平滑抗锯齿边界, 无硬锯齿、无描边、无投影; 填充为单一绿色平面色, 实体区白底合成均值 ≈ rgb(68,188,99)(≈#44BC63, e002)。","candidates":[]},{"id":"R1","description":"外缘剪影 = 以底盘基圆为半径基准、叠加沿角度周期分布的径向起伏(瓣凸起/凹口下陷); 基圆决定整体比例与圆心, 齿廓决定实际轮廓。","candidates":[]},{"id":"R2","description":"中心孔与底盘共用同一圆心, 孔是底盘的同心负形(挖除), 孔缘与外缘轮廓共享同一中心参数。","candidates":[]},{"id":"R3","description":"瓣顶、凹口底部与孔缘采用同样的圆角化+抗锯齿边界处理, 处处无尖角, 支持以单一光滑距离场统一生成内外轮廓。","candidates":[]}],"mechanisms":[],"sketches":[]}}

两个裁剪结论清晰：

- **e005(孔区 48×48)**: 孔心 ≈(261.5, 408), 与外接盒中心 (261, 407.5) 偏移 ≤1–2px → **同心成立**； 孔直径 ≈25–28px → 孔半径 ≈13±1.5px, 孔径/外径 ≈0.20–0.24(比早前 15–18px 估计更小， 需修正 F3)。
- **e006(左上 90° 弧段)**: 该象限内恰见 **2 瓣 + 2 凹口** → 角周期 45°, 确认 **N=8**; 结合 e003 东北象限凹口约在北偏东 22°, 采纳相位假设： 凹口中心位于 22.5°+k·45°, 瓣顶位于 k·45°(精度 ±10°, 留开放问题)。

现在更新 F2/F3 测量值， 并保存问题清单：

reasoning_details.text:
Let me analyze the new crop images carefully.

Image 5 (e005, 238-286 × 384-432, 48×48): Green background with a white circle (the hole) roughly centered. The white circle appears centered in the crop, maybe slightly right of center? The crop is centered on (262,408). The hole appears to span most of the middle: roughly from x=15 to x=38 (of 48), y=13 to y=36. So hole diameter ≈ 23px?? Hmm wait, that would make hole radius ≈ 11.5. Hmm, but visually the white circle in the 48px crop looks like it spans about half the width: ~10 to ~37 = 27px wide → r ≈ 13.5. Center ≈ ((10+37)/2, ...) = (23.5, ~24) → original ≈ (261.5, 408). 

So hole center ≈ (261.5, 408) — essentially coincides with bbox center (261, 407.5) → CONCENTRIC confirmed (offset ≤1-2px). Hole radius ≈ 12-14px (smaller than my earlier 15-18 estimate!). Hole diameter ~24-27px vs outer 122 → ratio ≈ 0.20-0.22. Hmm. Let me look again at image 5: green fills the whole frame; white circle roughly centered, diameter looks like ~55-60% of frame → 26-29px → r ≈ 13-14.5.

Actually in the displayed image, the white circle looks fairly large relative to frame — maybe 25-28px diameter. So hole r ≈ 13±1.5. Earlier estimate 15-18 was too big; refine to ~13-14, ratio r_hole/R_outer ≈ 13.5/61 ≈ 0.22.

Image 6 (e006, 196-262 × 342-408, 66×66): upper-left quadrant arc. The crop shows green mass in lower-right of frame with white background upper-left, and the gear's arc from 9:00 (left) to 12:00 (top). Looking at the render: green occupies bottom-right portion; the arc boundary goes from left edge (at some height) curving up to top edge (at right side). Along the arc I can see: bumps and dips. In the displayed image 6 (66×66 shown maybe 2x), I can discern: starting from bottom-left of the arc (9:00 direction) moving counterclockwise... The image shows: left edge has green extending up to about 40% height (a lobe around 9:00-10:00?), then a dip, then a bump peaking around 11:00?, a dip, then green reaching top edge near right (toward 12:00 region).

Let me count visible notches: I think I see 2 notches along this quadrant arc (one at ~10:00-10:30, one at ~11:30-12:00?) and correspondingly 2-3 lobes. If the quadrant (90°) contains 2 lobes + 2 notches → period 45° → N=8. If it contains 2.5 → N=10.

From the render, the arc looks like: lobe at ~9:30, notch at ~10:15, lobe at ~11:00, notch at ~11:45, lobe at ~12:30... hmm that would be consistent with 8 lobes at 45° spacing with lobes at 9:30, 11:00, 12:30 (i.e., starting angle offset ~15°?). Or lobes at 10:00, 11:15, 12:30?

Honestly, the small render makes exact phase hard. Key takeaway: 2 lobes + 2 notches per 90° → N=8 confirmed (period 45°). Phase: there appears to be a notch very close to 12:00 or a lobe at ~12:00? In image 6, at the top edge near the right (which corresponds to angles just left of 12:00 since crop right edge x=262 ≈ gear center x=261), the green reaches the top of the crop... The topmost green point in image 6 appears around x≈85-90% of frame → original x ≈ 196+0.87×66 ≈ 253 → slightly LEFT of center (261). The gear's topmost point (at center x=261) — in the crop that's x=65/66 = right edge. Hmm, at the right edge of image 6, does green touch the top? Looking at the image: top-right corner shows white? I think there's a small white area at top-right corner, and the green's top edge dips near the right edge → suggests a NOTCH near 12:00? But earlier from e001/image 2, I thought the top of the gear (12:00) had a lobe or was near a notch...

Hmm. In image 2 (e001 larger render), at 12:00 the edge looked like a gentle bump with notches adjacent at ~11:15 and ~12:45. But image 6 suggests near-12:00 dip. Conflict — or maybe what I see as "dip at right edge of image 6" is actually the notch at ~12:45 which in this crop is beyond the right edge (12:45 is right of center x=261 → not in crop; crop right edge = 262 ≈ center). So anything right of 12:00 isn't in image 6. The dip I see near the right edge must be at angle just LEFT of 12:00, e.g., 11:30-11:50.

So phase hypothesis: notch at ~11:40-ish? With N=8, notches at 45° spacing: if notch at 11:30 (i.e., -15° from vertical, or 345°), then notches at 345°, 30°, 75°, 120°, 165°, 210°, 255°, 300°; lobes at 0°, 45°, 90°, ... (12:00, 1:30, 3:00...). Hmm, but that puts a lobe exactly at 12:00 — contradicting the dip near 12:00. If instead notch at 0° (12:00): notches at 0,45,90...; lobes at 22.5°, 67.5°, ... — then in the 9:00-12:00 quadrant: notches at 270°(9:00) and 315°(10:30), lobes at 292.5° (9:45) and 337.5° (11:15). Then near 12:00 there's a notch center — the edge dips right at 12:00. That matches image 6's right-edge dip! And matches image 3 (e003, NE quadrant): notches at 0°(12:00) and 45°(1:30), lobes at 22.5° and 67.5°. In image 3, I saw a notch around 20-25° right of top — hmm, that matched lobe-at-22.5°? No wait, I saw a NOTCH at ~22° in image 3. Under "notch at 0,45" hypothesis, at 22.5° there should be a LOBE. Conflict.

Ugh. Let me re-examine image 3 (the small NE render): green at top-left; top edge has a notch around 1/3 width; right side yellow. The top edge of image 3: crop x 0-68 = orig x 262-330. The notch at ~1/3 → orig x ≈ 285. Angle from center (261,407.5): dx=24, dy=-56 → angle ≈ 23° right of vertical. So notch at ~22.5°. Under hypothesis A (lobes at 0,45,90: lobes at 12:00, 1:30): at 22.5° → notch. ✓ matches image 3's notch at 22°!

Under hypothesis A (lobes at 0°,45°,90°...), the 9:00-12:00 quadrant has: lobe at 9:00 (270°)? No wait — if lobes at 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 → lobes at 12:00, 1:30, 3:00, 4:30, 6:00, 7:30, 9:00, 10:30; notches at 22.5°, 67.5°, ... (11:15, 12:45, 2:15, ...). Then in the NW quadrant (9:00-12:00): lobes at 9:00, 10:30; notches at 11:15 and... 8:15 (not in quadrant). So quadrant arc from 9:00 (lobe peak) → notch at 10:30?? no wait: notches at 292.5° (=10:45 direction... let me redo in clock terms: 270°=9:00, 292.5°≈9:45, 315°=10:30, 337.5°≈11:15, 360°=12:00. Lobes at 270°, 315°, 360° → 9:00, 10:30, 12:00. Notches at 292.5° (9:45) and 337.5° (11:15).

So under hypothesis A, in image 6 (9:00→12:00 arc): starting at left edge (9:00, lobe peak at exactly left-center... the crop left edge x=196 is 5px left of gear's leftmost 200 — the 9:00 lobe apex at (200,407) is just outside crop left edge, but close), then dip at 9:45, bump at 10:30, dip at 11:15, bump at 12:00 (topmost point at x=261 = crop right edge 65-66). - Then advance_exploration_stage.

Actually, let me think about whether I should do the amend at all now, or later. The evidence_links map observation IDs to evidence IDs. Let me map:

- F1 (主体/外接盒/中心/半径): e001 (全轮廓裁剪). 
- F2 (齿廓): e001, e003, e004, e006 ( Northeast quadrant, SW quadrant, upper-left arc for counting). e006 confirmed N=8 count in 90° arc.
- F3 (中心孔): e005 (hole measurement), e001.

- R1 (剪影=基圆+径向起伏): e001, e006.
- R2 (同心孔): e005, e001.
- R3 (圆角+抗锯齿统一): e001, e003, e005, e006 — hmm, R3 is about edge treatment; evidence e001 mainly. Let me keep it simple: e001.

context_notes to add (task-level, not part of coverage denominator):
- Neighbor occlusion: 绿色片在黄片之上(绿在前), 缝隙≈0-2px; 依据 e001/e003/e004.
- Background: 白色圆角画布背景, 无投影; 目标为扁平纯色图形(无渐变/纹理/高光/阴影)。
- The gear teeth are "wave-like" rounded lobes — actually described in F2.
- Maybe note: 相邻黄色圆片同形状同尺寸(可作形状一致性佐证), 但本轮不建模。

Also the draft has empty gaps: [] — that's fine since all observations have candidate mechanisms... wait, actually mechanisms aren't bound yet. The "gaps" concept: "找不到方法的条目有具体 gaps". I believe F1-F4, R1-R3 all have plausible mechanisms, so gaps can stay empty. 

Wait — should I double check the open_questions format? The tool save_issues was already called. The receipt shows open_questions saved with refs ["F2","R1"], ["F2"], ["E1"]. Good.

One thing: the user request says "以过程式 Shader 复现为目标". So mechanisms should be shader-oriented: SDF-based gear shape, polar coordinate radial modulation, smooth union of circles for lobes, circle subtraction for hole, antialiasing via fwidth/smoothstep.

Now let me plan mechanisms (for next stage):

- M1: 极坐标径向波形 SDF (gear silhouette): distance from center r(θ) = R_base + A·waveform(N·θ + phase), where waveform is rounded square wave (e.g., smoothstep-based or cos^k clipped), lobes at k·45°, notches at 22.5°+k·45°. Or: r(θ) = R_notch + (R_lobe - R_notch)·w(Nθ), w being a periodic smooth bump. This covers F2, R1.

- M2: 多圆瓣并集 SDF: outer silhouette = smooth-union of 8 circles of radius r_lobe centered on ring radius R_ring around center, plus central base circle; notches emerge as the concave gaps between adjacent lobes. This is the classic "flower/gear" construction. Also covers F2, R1, and gives rounded transitions naturally.

- M3: 同心孔负形: final alpha = outer_SDF > 0 AND inner circle (r_hole) via max(d_outer, -d_hole) or d = max(d_gear, r_hole - dist). Covers F3, R2.

- M4: 边缘抗锯齿: coverage = smoothstep over SDF with fwidth-based width ≈1px; flat color fill. Covers F4, R3.

Alternative mechanisms:
- M5: 参数化贝塞尔/极坐标样条轮廓: 用角度驱动的样条(如 Catmull-Rom 过控制点) — probably unnecessary; keep 4 mechanisms maybe with one alternative for M2.

Actually, maybe include M5: " cosine-power lobe profile" as alternative to M2's smooth-union: r(θ)=R0 + A·|cos(Nθ/2)|^k style. Hmm, that gives 2N bumps if cos(Nθ)... Let me think: petals at k·45° with N=8: use cos(8θ)^p? cos(8θ) peaks at θ=0,45°,... yes period 45°, peaks at k·45°, troughs at 22.5°+k·45°. With power sharpening p to make lobes flatter-topped and notches rounded. That's a nice single-formula radial modulation. Could be M1's concrete instance or separate mechanism.

Let me define:

M1 name: "极坐标余弦瓣调制 SDF" — r(θ) = R0 + A·pow(max(cos(8·(θ-θ0)),0)... hmm need lobes flat-topped. Actually observed lobes look like rounded bumps (nearly circular lobes). The reference images show lobes that look like circular arcs (like a "flower/gear" with bulbous rounded teeth). The smooth-union-of-circles construction (M2) is likely the actual construction. I'll present both.

M1: 圆环瓣并集 + 基圆平滑并 (smooth union of circles) — classic flower/gear SDF:
  d = min over: base circle radius R_b; for i in 0..7: circle center at R_ring·(cos, sin)(θ_i), radius r_l; smooth-min with k to get rounded valleys. Notches depth controlled by R_ring, r_l. Phase offset θ0=22.5°... wait lobes at k·45° means θ_i = i·45° + phase0. With phase0=0 (lobes at 0°,45°,...). Hmm — but earlier I hypothesized notches at 22.5°+k·45° and lobes at k·45° (i.e., lobes at 12:00, 1:30...). With lobes at k·45°, phase0=0. Good.

Wait, actually, from the e001 crop: the top of the gear — is there a lobe at 12:00 or a notch? Looking at the e001 crop image (the green gear): The top edge appears to have a bump slightly right of top-center... and there seem to be notches at roughly 11:00 and 1:00... Actually with N=8 and lobes at k·45°: lobes at 12:00(0°), 1:30(45°), 3:00(90°), 4:30(135°), 6:00(180°), 7:30(225°), 9:00(270°), 10:30(315°). Notches at 11:15(22.5°), 12:45(67.5°), 2:15(112.5°), 3:45(157.5°), 5:15(202.5°), 6:45(247.5°), 8:15(292.5°), 9:45(337.5°).

From the e001 image: right side toward yellow gear: green edge at 3:00 area has a lobe? The green and yellow overlap region... The yellow gear at right has its left edge cutting into green region; green front. Hmm hard to verify. I'll keep phase as stated with ±10° uncertainty — fine.

Alternatively maybe lobes at 22.5°+k·45° instead (notches at k·45°)? My F2 description says notches at 22.5°+k·45° based on e003 (NE quadrant showing notch ~22° from north). Wait: "东北象限北偏东约 22° 处见凹口" — from e003 crop (NE quadrant), a notch around 22-25° east of north. If notches at 22.5°+k·45°, then at 22.5° there's a notch ✓. If lobes at 22.5°, then at 22.5° there'd be a lobe. The e003 crop shows a notch (dip) roughly there, so notches at 22.5°+k·45°. OK keep.

M2: 余弦幂径向调制 (single-formula alternative): r(θ) = R_min + A·(0.5+0.5·cos(8θ))^p style or |cos(4θ)|^p ... wait period must be 45°=π/4 rad. cos(8θ) has period 2π/8=π/4 ✓ peaks at θ=k·π/4 ✓. So r(θ)=R0+A·cos(8θ) smoothed/sharpened; p controls lobe roundness. Actually cos^p with even p gives rounded peaks and flat-ish valleys? cos^2(8θ): peaks 1 at k·45°, zero at 22.5°+k·45° — valleys pointed unless offset. r = R_min + A·cos²(8θ) gives rounded peaks and cusped valleys (r_min at notches with |∇r| finite? cos² has zero derivative at zero crossing... cos²(8θ) at θ=22.5°: cos(8θ)=cos(π/2·odd)=0, derivative of cos² is -8 sin(2·8θ)... at cos=0, sin=±1, derivative = -8·2·cos·sin = 0. Hmm derivative zero at valley → smooth rounded valley too actually. cos² has smooth maxima and smooth minima (minima are parabolic). So r(θ)=R_min+A·cos²(8θ) gives smooth bumps. But lobe shape would be smooth sinusoidal bulge rather than distinct circular lobes with concave notches. The observed shape has rather distinct circular lobes with pronounced rounded notches — smooth-union approach fits better. Keep M2 as alternative with adjustable sharpening.

M3: 同心孔负形 (SDF subtraction): d_final = max(d_gear, R_hole - r) (inside hole positive). Covers F3/R2.

M4: 覆盖率与纯色填充: alpha = 1 - smoothstep(-w, w, d_final) with w≈1px via fwidth; color constant #44BC63. Covers F4/R3 (+F1 partially).

Maybe also M5: "贝塞尔/多边形矢量轮廓挤出" — not shader-ish; skip. Or M5: "分层模板法": render base circle then subtract notches via periodic circle pattern at ring radius R_notch... Actually a neat alternative: notches = subtract 8 circles of radius r_n centered at R_ring_n at notch angles (22.5°+k·45°), union with base circle radius ~R_lobe-ish then... hmm: gear = union(base circle R=57, 8 lobe circles r≈7-8 at R=54) minus (8 notch circles r≈6-8 at R=57). This is M1 variant with explicit subtraction instead of smooth-union. Could be a separate mechanism M5 as alternative: "基圆+瓣圆并集, 再减凹口圆". Let me include it as M5 alternative to M1.

Actually, for sketch diversity, alternatives can swap M1↔M2 (two ways to make silhouette). M5 might be over-engineering; but it gives a third option with direct notch control. I'll include M5 briefly? The skill says mechanisms are reusable construction methods not bound to this image's consumers... bindings map F/R → mechanism list. Keep it to 4-5 mechanisms.

messages.content: 进入机制阶段(revision 5)。机制目录为空， 先整批定义 4 条机制并绑定到 F2/F3/F4/R1:

reasoning_details.text:
The stage has advanced to mechanisms. Now I need to propose mechanisms and bindings. Current mechanisms directory is empty, so I need to define complete mechanisms first (with id, name, method, conditions), and bind them to F/R targets.

Let me think about the mechanisms for reproducing this gear-shaped washer (green gear disc with center hole) as a procedural shader.

Key observations:
- F1: green gear-shaped disc body, near-circular flat disc, solid green fill, no gradient/texture/stroke/shadow; bbox ~(200,346)-(322,469), ~122×123px, center ~(261,407), max radius ~61px.
- F2: gear outer edge: 8 lobes / 8 notches, angular period 45°, notch centers at 22.5°+k·45°, lobe tops at k·45°, smooth rounded curves, no sharp corners; lobe top radius ≈61px, notch bottom radius ≈52-55px.
- F3: center hole: white near-circular hole concentric, hole center ≈(261.5,408), hole radius ≈13±1.5px, hole diameter/max diameter ≈0.20-0.24, ~1px smooth AA boundary.
- F4: edges all ~1px smooth AA, no aliasing/stroke/shadow; solid fill rgb(68,188,99) ≈ #44BC63.
- R1: outer silhouette = base circle + angularly periodic radial modulation (lobes up, notches down); base circle determines scale/center, tooth profile determines silhouette.
- R2: hole and disc share same center; hole is concentric negative shape (subtracted).
- R3: lobe tops, notch bottoms, hole edge all have same rounding+AA treatment, no sharp corners; supports a single smooth distance field unifying inner and outer contours.

Now, mechanisms (reusable construction methods, not bound to this graph's consumers):

M1: Angular cosine radial modulation distance field (gear silhouette via radial function)
Method: In SDF terms, compute r = length(p - center), θ = atan2(p.y - cy, p.x - cx). Define radial profile R(θ) = r_base + A·cos(N·(θ - φ0)) where N=8, φ0 is phase offset so notch centers land at 22.5°+k·45°. Coverage = r ≤ R(θ) with smoothstep AA on |r - R(θ)|. Tunables: r_base, amplitude A (between notch radius ~52-55 and lobe top ~61 → amplitude ≈ (61-53.5)/2 ≈ 3.75, mid radius ≈ 57.25), N (lobe count 8), phase φ0, AA width (~1-1.5px). This produces sinusoidal wavy edge — lobes and notches equally rounded, no sharp corners. This matches the "8 lobes smooth rounded" look.

M2: Superellipse lobe masks / union of rounded bumps (lobe overlay approach)
Method: Base circle radius r_base ≈ notch radius; union with 8 lobe circles of radius r_lobe centered at radius d from center at angles k·45° (lobe centers at k·45°), then round/blur the union via smooth-min or AA of max(). Coverage = max(smoothcircle(r, r_base), smoothlobe_i). Actually more like: coverage = smoothmax over [disk(r_base), 8 disks of radius r_lobe at distance d]. Smooth union (smin) gives rounded valleys. Tunables: r_base, r_lobe, d, smoothing k. This gives distinct rounded lobes with rounded notches — matches the look of rounded gear bumps.

Actually looking at the image, the gear shape looks like the classic "flower/gear" shape where lobes are more like rounded bumps — the outline appears wavy with rounded bumps and rounded valleys. Both M1 (sinusoidal radius) and M2 (union of circles + smooth rounding) are plausible candidate mechanisms. M2 might match better since the valleys look quite rounded and lobes fairly broad. Actually with only ~8px radial difference over 45° period, a sinusoid would look quite similar to union-of-circles. Good to have both as candidates.

M3: Annulus via SDF subtraction for the center hole
Method: final mask = outer_mask AND NOT hole_disk: alpha = smoothstep AA of (outer_SDF) combined with inverted hole SDF. Hole radius ≈13px at same center. Equivalent: d = max(d_outer, -d_hole) in SDF terms (annulus). Tunables: hole radius, center, AA width.

Actually, better to phrase M3 as "concentric annulus subtraction": coverage_final = coverage_outer × (1 - coverage_hole) with AA, or SDF max(d_outer, r_hole - r). Bind to F3, R2, and also F1/F4 partly.

M4: fwidth-based analytic anti-aliasing flat fill
Method: compute signed distance d for final shape; alpha = saturate(0.5 - d/fwidth(d)) or smoothstep(-w, w, -d) with w≈1px (or 1.5px). Fill color constant #44BC63. Ensures ~1px smooth edges everywhere, no stroke/shadow. Bind to F4, F1 (fill), and R3.

Also maybe M5: rounded notch shaping via smooth-min between lobes? I could fold that into M2. Keep 4 mechanisms max per batch — I can do one batch with 4 mechanisms and bindings in the same call (the example shows mechanisms + bindings same batch).

Wait — the tool schema for save_mechanisms: mechanisms max 4, bindings max 4. I have 7 targets to bind: F1, F2, F3, F4, R1, R2, R3. Bindings replace the complete candidate list for each target. I can only do 4 bindings per call, so I'll need two calls or prioritize.

Let me plan mechanisms:

- M1 "角度余弦径向调制齿轮轮廓" (cosine radial modulation): r(θ) = r_mid + A·cos(N·(θ−φ0)); coverage where r ≤ r(θ). N=8, φ0 chosen so notch centers at 22.5°+k·45° (i.e., cos minimum at those angles → φ0 = −22.5° relative... let's see: R(θ) = r_mid − A·cos(8(θ − 22.5°)) gives minima at θ = 22.5° + k·45°, maxima at θ = k·45°. Yes). Tunables: r_mid ≈ 56.5, A ≈ 4.5, N, φ0, AA width. Conditions: 适用当瓣凹起伏较浅(峰谷差≈8-9px)、瓣与凹等宽且圆滑、无需独立控制瓣宽时。

- M2 "基圆+圆瓣凸台的平滑并集" (smooth union of base disk and 8 lobe disks): coverage = smin(disk(r_base≈53), Σ disk_i(r_lobe≈? at d)) hmm. Let me parametrize: 8 lobe circles centered at radius d ≈ 53–55 from center, radius r_lobe ≈ 8–9, giving max extent d + r_lobe ≈ 61–62. Smooth-min (polynomial smin with k≈4-6px) rounds the concave junctions (valleys). Tunables: r_base, d, r_lobe, smin k. Conditions: 当瓣顶较平缓、凹口较深圆时更贴近; 若渲染显示谷过尖, 用 smin k 调整。

Hmm wait, actually looking at the crop images again: the green gear has quite pronounced rounded bumps. The valley between bumps is rounded. The classic way these flat-design gears are drawn: often union of circle + 8 rounded squares/bumps, or a "cog" made by boolean of circles. The e003 crop shows fairly wide rounded lobes. I'll keep both M1 and M2 as candidates.

- M3 "同心环减去中心孔" (annulus subtract): final alpha = outer_coverage × (1 − hole_coverage) or SDF d_final = max(d_outer, r_hole − r). Tunables: r_hole ≈ 13, same center. Bind to F3, R2.

- M4 "常数色填充 + fwidth 解析抗锯齿" (flat fill + analytic AA): alpha = smoothstep(w, −w, d_final) with w ≈ 1–1.5px via fwidth; color = uniform #44BC63; no stroke/shadow/gradient. Bind to F4, F1, R3.

Hmm, but binding M4 to F1 (主体盘面纯色填充) and M1 to F1... F1 is the disc body: base disk + fill + no extras. Bindings: F1: [M1 or M2?]. F1 is "近圆形扁平底盘...纯色绿色平面填充" — the body. Candidate mechanisms for F1: M1 (radial profile covering the body via base circle), M2 (base disk + lobes). I'd bind F1: [M1, M2]? reasoning_details.text: The save_mechanisms call failed because "name" field was missing — my JSON serialization apparently dropped the "name" fields. I need to resubmit with the name field included for each mechanism. Let me redo the call carefully with name fields.

mechanism_refs.reason: 余弦径向调制以 8 周期直接生成瓣顶位于 k·45°、凹口位于 22.5°+k·45° 的圆滑轮廓，峰谷半径锚点与观察一致(瓣顶≈61px，凹底≈52-55px)。
基圆+8 圆瓣凸台的 smin 并集同样给出圆滑瓣/凹；当瓣顶比正弦更平、凹口更宽圆时是更贴切的备选构造。
同心负形挖孔直接实现孔与外缘共圆心(偏心≤1-2px 按同心处理)、孔半径≈13px 的观察。
常数色 #44BC63 + fwidth 解析 AA 对应纯色平面填充与约 1px 平滑无描边/投影边界。
径向函数 R(θ) 即『基圆半径基准+角周期径向起伏』的直接参数化实现。
基圆盘叠加沿角度周期分布的圆瓣凸台是同一关系的另一可实现构造。

conditions: 瓣与凹等角宽、径向起伏浅(峰谷差≈8-9px)、瓣顶与凹底均圆滑的外形
不适合深齿/梯形齿或需独立控制瓣宽的情形
mechanisms.method: 以目标中心为极点取极坐标 (r,θ)，用径向函数 R(θ)=r_mid − A·cos(8·(θ−22.5°)) 直接给出外缘半径: 峰顶落在 θ=k·45°(≈61px)，谷底落在 θ=22.5°+k·45°(≈52-55px)，曲线处处光滑无尖角; 覆盖率 = r ≤ R(θ)，对 |r−R(θ)| 做 smoothstep 抗锯齿。可调: 瓣数 N、相位 φ0、中值半径 r_mid、振幅 A、AA 宽度。
mechanisms.name: 角度余弦径向调制齿轮轮廓

conditions: 瓣顶较平缓、凹口较宽圆时更贴近观察
瓣心半径与瓣半径需满足 d+r_lobe≈瓣顶半径 61px
mechanisms.method: 轮廓取基圆盘(半径 r_base≈52-55px)与 8 个圆瓣凸台(半径 r_lobe≈8px，圆心位于半径 d≈53px、角度 k·45° 处)的有符号距离平滑并集: d = smin(d_base，min_i d_lobe_i，k)，多项式平滑系数 k≈4-6px 将凹口底部圆角化; 再对 d 做 smoothstep 抗锯齿。约束 d+r_lobe ≈ 瓣顶半径 61px。可调: r_base、r_lobe、d、smin 系数 k、瓣数与相位。
mechanisms.name: 基圆与圆瓣凸台平滑并集

conditions: 孔与外缘同心、孔径/外缘最大径≈0.20-0.24 时适用; 观察偏心≤1-2px 可按同心处理
mechanisms.method: 与外轮廓共用同一圆心 uniform，构造半径 r_hole≈13px 的孔盘 SDF，最终形状 = 外轮廓盘减去孔盘: d_final = max(d_outer，−d_hole)(或 alpha = alpha_outer·(1−alpha_hole))，两段各自保留同宽 smoothstep 抗锯齿，得到环片。可调: 孔半径 r_hole、共享圆心。
mechanisms.name: 同心环负形挖孔

conditions: 目标为扁平纯色剪影、边缘约 1px 抗锯齿时适用
mechanisms.method: 对最终合成 SDF d_final 用 fwidth(d_final) 估计像素足迹，alpha = saturate(0.5 − d_final/(fwidth·w))，w≈1-1.5px，输出单一 uniform 常数色 ≈ #44BC63 (rgb 68,188,99); 不含描边、投影、渐变或纹理项。可调: AA 宽度系数 w、填充色 uniform。
mechanisms.name: 常数色填充与 fwidth 解析抗锯齿

mechanism_refs.reason: 余弦径向调制以 8 周期直接生成瓣顶位于 k·45°、凹口位于 22.5°+k·45° 的圆滑轮廓，峰谷半径锚点与观察一致(瓣顶≈61px，凹底≈52-55px)。
基圆+8 圆瓣凸台的 smin 并集同样给出圆滑瓣/凹；当瓣顶比正弦更平、凹口更宽圆时是更贴切的备选构造。
同心负形挖孔直接实现孔与外缘共圆心(偏心≤1-2px 按同心处理)、孔半径≈13px 的观察。
常数色 #44BC63 + fwidth 解析 AA 对应纯色平面填充与约 1px 平滑无描边/投影边界。
径向函数 R(θ) 即『基圆半径基准+角周期径向起伏』的直接参数化实现。
基圆盘叠加沿角度周期分布的圆瓣凸台是同一关系的另一可实现构造。

conditions: 瓣与凹等角宽、径向起伏浅(峰谷差≈8-9px)、瓣顶与凹底均圆滑的外形
不适合深齿/梯形齿或需独立控制瓣宽的情形
mechanisms.method: 以目标中心为极点取极坐标 (r,θ)，用径向函数 R(θ)=r_mid − A·cos(8·(θ−22.5°)) 直接给出外缘半径: 峰顶落在 θ=k·45°(≈61px)，谷底落在 θ=22.5°+k·45°(≈52-55px)，曲线处处光滑无尖角; 覆盖率 = r ≤ R(θ)，对 |r−R(θ)| 做 smoothstep 抗锯齿。可调: 瓣数 N、相位 φ0、中值半径 r_mid、振幅 A、AA 宽度。
mechanisms.name: 角度余弦径向调制齿轮轮廓

conditions: 瓣顶较平缓、凹口较宽圆时更贴近观察
瓣心半径与瓣半径需满足 d+r_lobe≈瓣顶半径 61px
mechanisms.method: 轮廓取基圆盘(半径 r_base≈52-55px)与 8 个圆瓣凸台(半径 r_lobe≈8px，圆心位于半径 d≈53px、角度 k·45° 处)的有符号距离平滑并集: d = smin(d_base，min_i d_lobe_i，k)，多项式平滑系数 k≈4-6px 将凹口底部圆角化; 再对 d 做 smoothstep 抗锯齿。约束 d+r_lobe ≈ 瓣顶半径 61px。可调: r_base、r_lobe、d、smin 系数 k、瓣数与相位。
mechanisms.name: 基圆与圆瓣凸台平滑并集

conditions: 孔与外缘同心、孔径/外缘最大径≈0.20-0.24 时适用; 观察偏心≤1-2px 可按同心处理
mechanisms.method: 与外轮廓共用同一圆心 uniform，构造半径 r_hole≈13px 的孔盘 SDF，最终形状 = 外轮廓盘减去孔盘: d_final = max(d_outer，−d_hole)(或 alpha = alpha_outer·(1−alpha_hole))，两段各自保留同宽 smoothstep 抗锯齿，得到环片。可调: 孔半径 r_hole、共享圆心。
mechanisms.name: 同心环负形挖孔

conditions: 目标为扁平纯色剪影、边缘约 1px 抗锯齿时适用
mechanisms.method: 对最终合成 SDF d_final 用 fwidth(d_final) 估计像素足迹，alpha = saturate(0.5 − d_final/(fwidth·w))，w≈1-1.5px，输出单一 uniform 常数色 ≈ #44BC63 (rgb 68,188,99); 不含描边、投影、渐变或纹理项。可调: AA 宽度系数 w、填充色 uniform。
mechanisms.name: 常数色填充与 fwidth 解析抗锯齿
